patterns: VIBRO is not working and LED is not on
responses:
To fix the VIBRO (NOT ON LED), follow these steps:
1. CHECK THE FUSE -> REPLACE FUSE.
2. CHECK THE POWER SUPPLY -> REPLACE POWER SUPPLY.
3. CHECK THE SUPPLY VOLTAGE (11v TO 14V) -> REPLACE POWER SUPPLY.
4. CHECK THE GUN ELEMENT SHORT -> REPLACE THE GUN.
5. REPLACE THE DC CONNECTOR.
6. CHECK THE STIRRER BOARD -> REPLACE THE STIRRER BOARD.

patterns: VIBRO is not working but LED just goes on and off
Vibro LED blinking but not working
Vibro LED flashes on and off
responses:
To troubleshoot VIBRO (LED JUST ON AND OFF):
1. CHECK THE GUN ELEMENT SHORT -> REPLACE THE GUN.
2. CHECK DC CONNECTOR -> REPLACE THE DC CONNECTOR.
3. CHECK THE STIRRER BOARD -> REPLACE THE STIRRER BOARD.

patterns: Machine is on but vibration is not present
responses:
To resolve VIBRO (MACHINE ON BUT NO VIBRATION):
1. CHECK THE SUPPLY VOLTAGE (11v TO 14V) -> REPLACE POWER SUPPLY.
2. CHECK THE GUN ELEMENT SHORT -> REPLACE THE GUN.
3. CHECK THE FREQ.POT AND CABLE -> REPLACE THE FREQ.POT.
4. CHECK THE STIRRER BOARD -> REPLACE THE STIRRER BOARD.

To fix VIBRO (MACHINE CONTINIOUSLY VIBRATING):
1. CHECK THE TIMER POT. AND CABLE -> REPLACE THE TIMER POT.
2. CHECK THE STIRRER BOARD -> REPLACE THE STIRRER BOARD.

To fix VIBRO (LOW VIBRATION):
1. CHECK THE SUPPLY VOLTAGE (11v TO 14V) -> REPLACE POWER SUPPLY.
2. CHECK THE FREQ.POT AND CABLE -> REPLACE THE FREQ.POT.
3. CHECK THE STIRRER BOARD FREQ.TRIMPOT ADJUST -> ADJUST THE FREQ.TRIMPOT.
4. CHECK THE STIRRER BOARD -> REPLACE THE STIRRER BOARD.

patterns: Vibration indication LED is not working
responses:
To troubleshoot VIBRO (VIBRATION INDICATION LED NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE LED IS WORKING AND CHECK THE CONNECTING CABLE QUALITY -> REPLACE THE LED AND CABLE ASSY.
2. CHECK THE VOLTAGE OF THE INDICATION LINE -> REPLACE THE STIRRER BOARD.

patterns: Power LED is not working on vibro
responses:
To troubleshoot VIBRO (POWER LED NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE LED IS WORKING AND CHECK THE CONNECTING CABLE QUALITY -> REPLACE THE LED AND CABLE ASSY.
2. CHECK THE VOLTAGE OF THE INDICATION LINE -> REPLACE THE STIRRER BOARD.

patterns: Stirrer working only during adapter plugging time
Vibro not working by the push switch
Push switch not starting vibro stirrer
responses:
To fix VIBRO (STIRRER WORKING ONLY THE ADAPTER PLUGGING TIME / PUSH SWITCH FAIL):
1. CHECK THE KEY FUNCTIONALITY AND CABLE ASSY. QUALITY -> REPLACE THE KEY.
2. CHECK THE STIRRER BOARD -> REPLACE THE STIRRER BOARD.

patterns: Not present the battery charging voltage - 0V
Solar charger board voltage is zero
responses:
To fix SOLAR CHARGER BOARD (BATTERY CHARGING VOLTAGE - 0V):
1. CHECK THE CHARGER ADAPTER VOLTAGES - 12.5V AND 24V -> REPLACED THE CHARGER ADAPTER.
2. CHECK THE CHARGER FUSE -> REPLACE THE FUSE.
3. CHECK THE CHARGER ADAPTER TO SOLARCHARGER BOARD WIRING.
4. CHECK THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD COMPONENTS DAMAGE -> REPLACE THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD.

To fix SOLAR CHARGER BOARD (BATTERY CHARGING VOLTAGE IS LOW):
1. CHECK THE CHARGER ADAPTER VOLTAGES - 12.5V AND 24V -> REPLACED THE CHARGER ADAPTER.
2. REMOVE THE BATTERY AND CHECK THE VOLTAGE ADJUST TRIM.POT. OF THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD -> REPLACE THE CHARGER BOARD.

patterns: Battery charging voltage is too high
responses:
To fix SOLAR CHARGER BOARD (BATTERY CHARGING VOLTAGE IS TOO HIGH):
1. REMOVE THE BATTERY AND CHECK THE VOLTAGE ADJUST TRIM.POT. OF THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD -> REPLACE THE CHARGER BOARD.

patterns: Battery charging voltage is correct but battery not charging
Voltage is fine but battery won't charge
responses:
To fix SOLAR CHARGER BOARD (VOLTAGE CORRECT BUT BATTERY NOT CHARGING):
1. CHECK THE BATTERY CONDITION -> REPLACE THE BATTERY.
2. CHECK THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD COMPONENTS DAMAGE -> REPLACE THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD.

patterns: Battery charging indication LED not working
responses:
To fix SOLAR CHARGER BOARD (BATTERY CHARGING INDICATION LED NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE BATTERY CONDITION -> REPLACE THE BATTERY.
2. CHECK THE LED IS WORKING AND CHECK THE CONNECTING CABLE QUALITY -> REPLACE THE LED AND CABLE ASSY.
3. CHECK THE VOLTAGE OF THE CURRENT INDICATION LINE -> REPLACE THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD.

To fix SOLAR CHARGER BOARD (LOW VOLTAGE CUTOFF NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE LOW VOLTAGE CUTOFF RELAY(K2) IS WORKING(POWER ON SWITCH SUDDEN ON/OFF/ON) -> REPLACE THE SOLARCHARGER BOARD.

patterns: Low voltage cutoff LED not working
responses:
To fix SOLAR CHARGER BOARD (LOW VOLTAGE CUTOFF LED NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE LED IS WORKING AND CHECK THE CONNECTING CABLE QUALITY -> REPLACE THE LED AND CABLE ASSY.
2. CHECK THE VOLTAGE OF THE CUTOFF INDICATION LINE -> REPLACE THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD.

patterns: Machine full time working from battery but battery not full
responses:
To fix SOLAR CHARGER BOARD (MACHINE FULL TIME WORKING FROM BATTERY):
1. CHECK THE CHARGER ADAPTER VOLTAGES - 12.5V AND 24V -> REPLACE THE CHARGER ADAPTER.
2. CHECK THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD LOW VOLTAGE SETTING TRIM POT. -> REPLACE THE SOLARCHARGER BOARD.
3. CHECK THE CHARGER ADAPTER DETECTION RELAY(K1) IS WORKING -> REPLACE THE SOLARCHARGER BOARD.

patterns: Machine not working from the external connected battery
responses:
To fix SOLAR CHARGER BOARD (NOT WORKING FROM EXTERNAL BATTERY):
1. CHECK THE EXTERNAL BATTERY VOLTAGE ABOVE 11.5V -> CHARGE THE EXTERNAL BATTERY.
2. CHECK THE RELAY(K1) IS WORKING (USE THE CHARGER ADAPTER) -> REPLACE THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD.
3. CHECK THE LOW VOLTAGE CUTOFF TRIM POT. OF THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD -> REPLACE THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD.

patterns: Adapter output voltage is zero LSE V3 ECO V
responses:
To fix COMPACT ADAPTER (OUTPUT VOLTAGE IS ZERO):
1. CHECK THE STATUS LED IS GLOWING.
2. OPEN THE ADAPTER AND CHECK PCB QUALITY( COMPONENTS BURN OR NOT).
3. CHECK THE AC CORD -> REPLACE AC CORD.
4. CHECK THE ADAPTER PCB -> REPLACE THE ADAPTER PCB.

patterns: Adapter output voltage is zero but LED is glowing
0V output but adapter light is on
responses:
To fix COMPACT ADAPTER (OUTPUT VOLTAGE ZERO BUT LED GLOWING):
1. CHECK THE OUTPUT DC CONNECTER OF THE ADAPTER -> REPLACE THE OUTPUT DC CABLE.

To fix COMPACT ADAPTER (OUTPUT SHOWING 8V TO 9V):
1. OPEN THE ADAPTER AND CHECK PCB QUALITY( COMPONENTS BURN OR NOT) -> REPLACE THE ADAPTER PCB.

patterns: Charger adapter output voltage is zero LSE-S V3 ECOD ECOSV
responses:
To fix CHARGER ADAPTER (OUTPUT VOLTAGE ZERO):
1. CHECK THE STATUS LED IS GLOWING.
2. OPEN THE ADAPTER AND CHECK PCB QUALITY( COMPONENTS BURN OR NOT).
3. CHECK THE AC CORD -> REPLACE AC CORD.
4. CHECK THE CHARGER ADAPTER PCB -> REPLACE THE CHARGER ADAPTER PCB.

patterns: Charger adapter output voltage is zero but LED is glowing
responses:
To fix CHARGER ADAPTER (OUTPUT ZERO BUT LED GLOWING):
1. CHECK THE OUTPUT DC CONNECTER OF THE ADAPTER -> REPLACE THE OUTPUT DC CABLE.

patterns: Adapter output 12 voltage showing 8V to 9V but 24V is 24V
12V line is low on charger adapter
responses:
To fix CHARGER ADAPTER (12V SHOWING 8V TO 9V AND 24V IS 24V):
1. OPEN THE ADAPTER AND CHECK PCB QUALITY( COMPONENTS BURN OR NOT) -> REPLACE THE CHARGER ADAPTER PCB.

patterns: Adapter output 12 voltage showing 12V and 24V is low voltage or zero
responses:
To fix CHARGER ADAPTER (12V OK, 24V LOW OR ZERO):
1. OPEN THE ADAPTER AND CHECK PCB QUALITY( COMPONENTS BURN OR NOT) -> REPLACE THE CHARGER ADAPTER PCB.

patterns: System on time please wait notification continuously showing
responses:
To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (PLEASE WAIT CONTINUOUSLY SHOWING):
1. CHECK THE SD CARD IS OK -> REPLACE THE SD CARD.

patterns: Display is blank on DPST board
responses:
To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (DISPLAY BLANK):
1. CHECK THE DPST BOARD BREATHING LED IS BLINKING -> REPLACE THE DPST BOARD.
2. CHECK THE DIRECTION OF THE DISPLAY FRC CABLE CONNECTOR -> CONNECT THE FRC CONNECTOR AT OPPOSITE DIRECTION.
3. CHECK THE DISPLAY FRC CABLE QUALITY AND LCD QUALITY -> REPLACE THE DISPLAY.

patterns: Only half the screen is working
responses:
To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (DISPLAY SHOWN HALF PORTION ONLY):
1. CHECK THE DPST TO LCD FRC CABLE AND CONNECTOR QUALITY -> REPLACE THE DPST TO LCD CABLE.
2. CHECK THE DISPLAY MODULE FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE LCD MODULE.
3. CHECK THE DPST BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE DPST BOARD.

patterns: Restart time time changed or re-setted
responses:
To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (RTC TIME NOT SAVED):
1. CHECK THE CMOS BATTERY VOLTAGE ABOVE 2V -> REPLACE THE CMOS BATTERY.
2. CHECK THE U5 AND PROCESSOR CONNECTING LINE SOLDERING -> RE-SOLDER THAT CONNECTION.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (RTC TIME NOT RUNNING):
1. CHECK THE U5 IC CRYSTAL - Y3 AND ALSO CHECK C37 & C38 -> REPLACE THE Y3 CRYSTAL AND C37&C38.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (DPST KEY PAD NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE DIRECTION OF THE KEYPAD FRC-10 CABLE CONNECTOR -> CONNECT THE FRC-10 CONNECTOR AT OPPOSITE DIRECTION.
2. CHECK THE DPST KEYPAD QUALITY -> REPLACE THE DPST KEYPAD.
3. CHECK THE DPST BOARD QUALITY -> REPLACE THE DPST BOARD.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (USB INITIALIZATION ERROR):
1. CHECK THE DPST TO BACKPANEL CABLE QUALITY AND DIRECTION OF THE FRC CONNECTOR -> REPLACE THE FRC CABLE OR CONNECT OPPOSITE.
2. CONNECT THE NEW BACK PANEL BOARD AND CHECK -> REPLACE THE DPST BOARD.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (WEIGHING SCALE NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE REQUIRED SETTINGS IS APPLIED -> SET THE REQUIRED SETTINGS VALUES.
2. CHECK THE SCALE INTERFACING CABLE CONNECTIVITY -> REPLACE THE CABLE.
3. CHECK THE BACK PANEL TO DPST SCALE CABLE -> REPLACE THE CABLE.
4. CHECK THE BACKPANEL PCB FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE PCB.
5. CHECK THE DPST BOARD FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE THE DPST BOARD.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (COMPUTER OUTPUT NOT PRESENT):
1. CHECK THE DATAOUTPUT FORMAT OF THE ANALYZER SETTINGS -> SET REQUIRED VALUES.
2. CHECK THE MACHINE COMPUTER OUT TO COMPUTER CABLE CONNECTIVITY -> REPLACE CABLE.
3. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAIN BOARD TO BACKPANEL INTERFACING CABLE -> REPLACE CABLE.
4. CHECK THE BACKPANEL PCB FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE PCB.
5. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAIN BOARD FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE MAIN BOARD.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (EXTERNAL DISPLAY DATA NOT PRESENT):
1. CHECK THE MACHINE EXTERNAL DISPLAY OUT TO DISPLAY CABLE CONNECTIVITY -> REPLACE CABLE.
2. CHECK THE DPST BOARD TO BACKPANEL EXTERNAL DISPLAY CABLE -> REPLACE CABLE.
3. CHECK THE BACKPANEL PCB FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE PCB.
4. CHECK THE DPST BOARD FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE DPST BOARD.

patterns: Rate not taken from the chart
responses:
To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (RATE NOT TAKEN FROM THE CHART / NOT VIEW):
1. CHECK THE SD CARD IS OK -> REPLACE THE SD CARD.
2. CHECK THE RATE CHART FILE IS SAVED IN THE SD CARD.
3. CHECK THE SAVED FILE TYPE AND DATAS FORMAT IN CSV -> SAVE TO THE CORRECT FORMAT AND TYPE (CSV).
4. CHECK THE DPST BOARD FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE THE DPST BOARD.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (FARMER DETAILS NOT SHOWN):
1. CHECK THE SD CARD IS OK -> REPLACE THE SD CARD.
2. CHECK THE RATE CHART FILE IS SAVED IN THE SD CARD.
3. CHECK THE SAVED FILE TYPE AND DATAS FORMAT IN CSV -> SAVE AS CSV.
4. CHECK THE DPST BOARD FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE THE DPST BOARD.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (ANALYZER CONNECTIVITY ERROR):
1. CHECK THE ANALYZER TO DPST BOARD INTERFACING CABLE AND CONNECTOR QUALITY -> REPLACE CABLE.
2. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAIN BOARD FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE MAIN BOARD.
3. CHECK THE ANALYZER DPST BOARD FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE DPST BOARD.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (WIFI/GSM MODULE ERROR SHOWN):
1. CHECK THE WIFI/GSM SETTINGS DETAILS -> ENTER THE REQUIRED SETTINGS.
2. CHECK THE DPST TO BACKPANEL FRC CABLE AND CONNECTION DIRECTION -> REPLACE OR RECONNECT FRC CABLE.
3. CHECK THE WIFI/GSM MODULE BREATHING LED IS WORKING -> REPLACE THE WIFI/GSM MODULE.
4. CHECK THE ANTENNA SMA CABLE CONNECTION AND CONNECTOR -> REPLACE THE ANTENNA AND SMA CABLE.

patterns: SMS not send to the farmer
responses:
To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (SMS NOT SEND TO THE FARMER):
1. CHECK THE GSM/SIM MODULE CONNECTIVITY (INSERTED SIM DIRECTION) AND SIM VALIDITY -> CORRECT CONNECTIVITY / EXTEND VALIDITY.
2. CHECK THE FARMER DETAILS ENTERED ARE CORRECT -> PROPERLY ENTER DETAILS.
3. CHECK THE ENTERED SMS ENABLE SETTINGS ARE CORRECT -> ENTER CORRECT SETTINGS.

patterns: Tested result to cloud updation error shown
responses:
To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (TESTED RESULT TO CLOUD UPDATION ERROR):
1. CHECK THE WIFI/GSM CONNECTIVITY -> ENTER PROPER SETTINGS.
2. CHECK THE ENTERED CLOUD DETAILS ARE CORRECT -> ENTER PROPER CLOUD ADDRESS.
3. CHECK THE SAME MACHINE ID AND MODEL DETAILS ARE ENTERED IN CLOUD APPLICATION -> ENTER IN WEB APPLICATION.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (CHART/FARMER/COLLECTION NOT SAVED):
1. CHECK THE SD CARD FILE FORMAT TYPE- (USE FAT SYSTEM) -> FORMAT THE SD CARD AT FAT FILE SYSTEM USE THE COMPUTER.
2. CHECK THE SD CARD IS DETECTED THE MACHINE (READ/WRITABLE) -> FORMAT THE SD CARD USE THAT MACHINE.

patterns: Sample testing time the count continuously counted above 50 seconds
responses:
To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (SAMPLE TESTING TIME CONTINUOUSLY COUNTED ABOVE 50 SEC):
1. CHECK THE DPST BOARD TO ANALYZER MAIN BOARD INTERFACE CABLE -> REPLACE CABLE.
2. CHECK THE DPST BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE DPST BOARD.
3. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAIN BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE MAIN BOARD.

patterns: DPST board to analyzer main board communication not properly working
responses:
To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (COMMUNICATION NOT PROPERLY WORKING):
1. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAINBOARD MACHINE MODEL SELECTION IS 'ECOD'.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (PENDRIVE DETECTION FAILURE):
1. CHECK THE PENDRIVE FUNCTIONALITY AND FILE FORMAT IS FAT FILE SYSTEM -> CHANGE FILE FORMAT TO FAT.
2. CHECK THE BACKPANEL BOARD FUCTIONALITY -> REPLACE BACKPANEL BOARD.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (EXTERNAL KEYBOARD NOT DETECTED):
1. CHECK THE DPST BOARD TO BACKPANEL BOARD FRC CABLE QUALITY AND CONNECTOR DIRECTION -> REPLACE OR RECONNECT FRC CABLE.
2. CHECK THE BACKPANEL BOARD FUCTIONALITY -> REPLACE BACKPANEL BOARD.
3. CHECK THE DPST BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE DPST BOARD.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (EXTERNAL DISPLAY NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE DPST BOARD TO BACKPANEL BOARD FRC CABLE QUALITY AND CONNECTOR DIRECTION -> REPLACE OR RECONNECT FRC CABLE.
2. CHECK THE BACKPANEL BOARD FUCTIONALITY -> REPLACE BACKPANEL BOARD.
3. CHECK THE DPST BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE DPST BOARD.
4. CHECK THE EXTERNAL DISPLAY INTERFACING CABLE -> REPLACE EXTERNAL DISPLAY INTERFACING CABLE.

To fix ECOD-DPST BOARD (PRINTER NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE PRINTER POWER SUPPLY - 8 TO 9V -> CHANGE THE POWER CABLE OR PRINTER SUPPLY BOARD.
2. CHECK THE PRINTER FUNCTIONALLY WORKING - SELF TEST PRINTOUT -> CHANGE THE PRINTER.
3. CHECK THE PRINTER SETTINGS -> CHANGE THE SETTINGS.
4. CHECK THE COMMUNICATION CABLE -> CHANGE THE CABLE.

To fix PUMP (NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAINBOARD BREATHING LIGHT IS WORKING -> REPLACE THE ANALYZER BOARD.
2. CHECK THE MOTOR CABLE AND CONNECTOR CONNECTIVITY -> REPLACE THE MOTOR.
3. CHECK THE MOTOR MOTION SENSING BOARD CABLE AND CONNECTOR -> REPLACE THE CABLE.
4. CHECK THE MOTOR MOTION SENSOR BOARD FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE THE MOTOR MOTION SENSOR BOARD.
5. CHECK THE MOTOR DRIVER MODULE QUALITY -> REPLACE THE MOTOR DRIVER MODULE.
6. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE ANALYZER MAINBOARD.

patterns: Pump nut and bolt move to oneside only and hit into the clamp
responses:
To fix PUMP (NUT AND BOLT MOVE TO ONESIDE AND HIT CLAMP):
1. CHECK THE MOTOR MOTION SENSING BOARD CABLE AND CONNECTOR -> REPLACE THE MOTOR MOTION SENSING BOARD CABLE.
2. CHECK THE MOTOR MOTION SENSING BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE SENSING BOARD.
3. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE ANALYZER MAINBOARD.

To fix PUMP (PUMP SENSE ERROR):
1. CHECK THE MOTOR MOTION SENSING BOARD CABLE AND CONNECTOR -> REPLACE SENSING BOARD CABLE.
2. CHECK THE MOTOR MOTION SENSING BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE SENSING BOARD.
3. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE ANALYZER MAINBOARD.

To fix ECOD/ECOSV/LSES V3 BATTERY PROBLEMS (LOW BATTERY ERROR):
1. CHECK THE BATTERY VOLT ABOVE 11.5V -> REPLACE THE BATTERY.
2. CHECK THE SOLARCHARGER BOARD TO ANALYZER INTERFACE CABLE -> REPLACE THE INTERFACE CABLE.
3. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE ANALYZER MAINBOARD.
4. CHECK THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD FUNCTANALITY -> REPLACE THE SOLAR CHARGER BOARD.

patterns: Battery full LED indication not working
responses:
To fix ECOD/ECOSV/LSES V3 BATTERY PROBLEMS (BATTERY FULL LED NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAINBOARD IS COMPLETED THE WARMING PROCESS -> APPLY TO CANCELLED THE WARMING PROCESS.
2. CHECK THE VOLTAGE OF THE BATTERY ABOVE 14.3V -> CHARGE THE BATTERY AT FULL.
3. CHECK THE CHARGER BOARD TO ANALYZER MAINBOARD INTERFACING CABLE -> REPLACE CABLE.
4. CHECK VOLTAGE OF SOLAR CHARGER BOARD TO BATTERY CABLE LINE WITHOUT CONNECTING BATTERY (14.45V) -> ADJUST TRIMPOT AND SET AT 14.45V.
5. CHECK THE BATTERY FULL INDICATION LED IS WORKING -> REPLACE THE LED.
6. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAIN BOARD TO LED CABLE -> REPLACE CABLE.
7. CHECK THE ANALYZER MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE MAINBOARD.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (T2/TEMP.SET ERROR):
1. CHECK THE LEAKAGE/BLOCK OF THE SAMPLE SUCKING SECTIONS.
2. CHECK THE INLET PIPE IS BROKEN OR BLOCKED -> REPLACE INLET PIPE.
3. CHECK THE INLET TUBE TO PREHEATER SILICON TUBE -> REPLACE/TIE SILICON TUBE.
4. CHECK THE PRE HEATER TO SENSOR SILICON TUBE -> REPLACE/TIE SILICON TUBE.
5. CHECK THE SENSOR TO SYRINGE SILICON TUBE -> REPLACE/TIE SILICON TUBE.
6. CHECK THE SYRINGE IS DAMAGE -> REPLACE THE SYRINGE.
7. CHECK THE BELLOW TO L-PLUG SILICON TUBE BROKEN OR BUR HOLDED -> REPLACE SILICON TUBE/BUR.
8. CHECK THE L-PLUG BROKEN AND O-RING QUALITY -> REPLACE L-PLUG/O-RING.
9. CHECK THE BELLOW QUALITY -> REPLACE BELLOW.
10. CHECK THE SENSOR INNER BOX SIDE ANY LEAKAGE/BLOCK -> REPLACE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.
11. CHECK MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (BOX TEMP ERROR):
1. CHECK THE JUMPER QUALITY OF THE MAINBOARD TO SENSOR BOARD SUPPLY LINE -> REPLACE THE JUMPER.
2. CHECK THE SENSOR BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE SENSOR BOARD.
3. CHECK THE MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (SAMPLE NOT FOUND/AIR IN MILK):
1. CHECK THE SAMPLE SUCKING SECTION ANY LEAKAGE/BLOCK -> REPLACE THE DAMAGE ITEM.
2. CHECK THE MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (PLUNGE IN WATER/WATER IN SENSOR):
1. CHECK THE SAMPLE LIQUID PRESENTS IN THE SENSOR TUBE -> REMOVE THE SAMPLE LIQUID.
2. CHECK THE MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (HOT SAMPLE ERROR):
1. CHECK THE TEST SAMPLE TEMPERATURE BELOW 40 DEGREE -> REPLACE THE SAMPLE.
2. CHECK THE SENSOR BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.
3. CHECK THE MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (COUNT ZERO / RESULT ZERO):
1. CHECK THE SENSOR BLOCK / LEAKAGE AND TEST COUNT VALUE -> CLEAN THE SENSOR.
2. CHECK THE SENSOR GAIN SET AT PROPER VALUE -> SET THE NORMAL GAIN SETTINGS.
3. CHECK THE SENSOR BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE SENSOR BOARD.
4. CHECK MAIN BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR PAIR.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (READING VARIATION):
1. CHECK THE SENSOR AND SILICONE TUBES ARE CLEANED -> CLEAN THE SENSOR AND SILICONE TUBES.
2. CHECK THE SENSOR GAIN SET AT PROPER VALUE -> SET THE NORMAL GAIN SETTINGS.
3. CHECK THE PROPER OFFSET APPLY AND TEST READING -> REPLACE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.
4. CHECK MAIN BOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR PAIR.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (FAT SHOWN IN WATER):
1. CHECK THE ANALYZER OTHER MILK SAMPLES TEST READINGS ARE 'OK' -> IF NOT OK CHECK THE CALIBRATION DETAILS.
2. CHECK THE SENSOR AND TUBE WELL CLEANED -> TO CLEAN THE SENSOR AND TUBE, APPLY WATER ZERO OPERATION AND TEST AGAIN.
3. ENSURE THE PAIRED MAIN BOARD IS FUNCTIONALLY OK OTHERWISE BOARD REPLACE.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (LCD CONTINIOUSLY SHOWING COMPUTER MODE):
1. CHECK THE FRONTPANEL KEYPAD KEYS QUALITY -> REPLACE THE KEYPAD.
2. CHECK THE MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (LCD CONTINIOUSLY SHOWING VERSION):
1. CHECK THE FRONTPANEL KEYPAD KEYS QUALITY -> REPLACE THE KEYPAD.
2. CHECK THE MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.

patterns: WARMING STARTING TIME MACHINE WILL OFF
responses:
To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (WARMING STARTING TIME MACHINE WILL OFF/FUSE BURN):
1. CHECK THE MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY - MOSFET FAILURE -> REPLACE MAIN BOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.
2. CHECK THE SENSOR BOARD COIL IS BURN -> REPLACE MAIN BOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.
3. CHECK THE ON/OFF SWITCH FUNCTIONALITY AND FUSE CARRER & FUSE IS TIGHT -> REPLACE SWITCH OR RE-SET FUSE AND CARRIER.
4. CHECK THE POWER CABLE OR CONNECTOR IS LOOSE -> REPLACE FAULTY ITEM.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (PENDRIVE AND KEYBOARD NOT DETECTED):
1. CHECK THE MAINBOARD USB SETTING IS CORRECT -> CORRECT THE USB SETTINGS.
2. CHECK THE USB CONNECTOR AND INTERFACING CABLE -> REPLACE THE CONNECTOR OR CABLE.
3. CHECK THE MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR BOARD PAIR.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (WIFI/GSM MODULE ERROR SHOWN):
1. CHECK THE WIFI/GSM SETTINGS DETAILS -> ENTER REQUIRED SETTINGS.
2. CHECK THE MAINBOARD TO MODULES OR BACKPANEL FRC CABLE -> REPLACE OR RECONNECT AT CORRECT DIRECTION.
3. CHECK THE WIFI/GSM MODULE BREATHING LED IS WORKING -> REPLACE MODULE.
4. CHECK THE ANTENNA SMA CABLE CONNECTION AND CONNECTOR -> REPLACE ANTENNA AND SMA CABLE.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (FRONTPANEL KEYPAD NOT WORKING):
1. CHECK THE KEYPAD, INTERFACING CABLE AND CONNECTOR QUALITY -> REPLACE THE KEYPAD, INTERFACING CABLE AND CONNECTOR.
2. CHECK THE MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR PAIR.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (LCD NOT WORKING - BLANK DISPLAY):
1. CHECK THE LCD, INTERFACE CABLE AND CONNECTOR QUALITY -> REPLACE THE LCD, INTERFACING CABLE AND CONNECTOR.
2. CHECK THE MAINBOARD FUNCTIONALITY -> REPLACE THE MAINBOARD AND SENSOR PAIR.

To fix ANALYZER MAINBOARD (RTC TIME NOT RUNNING):
